caveats: Read AGENTS.md and both requested JSON files only. Reviewed all 57 SUPPORTED_FOR_PILOT links: P01=9, P02=14, P03=18, P04=16 (51 distinct cases). Compared every accepted link reason, supported_scope and condition_limit with its card definition/include_if/exclude_if and registry problem/task/context. All catalog evidence quotes match their registry fields. Four holds leave 53 links without a clear contradiction under this audit scope.

This is an independent reasoning pass over the stored source summaries, not a blinded review or an original-publication verification. The four user-supplied suspicions were visible. No fresh question files, rankings, relevance labels, external sources, or APIs were opened or used.

A hold is limited to the named perspective-case assignment. It does not reject the case globally or change any catalog status. No query-to-case fit, outcome-based selection, scores, or additional acceptance requirements were introduced.

P01 AXV2N_0133 is retained: investigating claim-processing questions together with navigating claim-decision logs and contractual variables supports the catalog-limited investigation/reference scope. This does not assert a general document search engine. P01 AXV2H_0091_01 has explicit internal product knowledge search in context, so the actual P/T/C jointly supports that limited function.

P01 AXV24_f27ca1e6fb82 is retained: its task explicitly performs integrated knowledge search across internal systems and context identifies employee information exploration. The integration-build burden differs from a direct search-time burden, but useful reference scope does not require an identical problem. The historical review_changes entry is not treated as current link status.

P02 permits classification as well as extraction/structuring. Retained AXV24_06318a4a88a8 for its explicit expense classification task and manual-input problem without assuming OCR; retained AXV2P2_0069_01 for creating CRM contact records from customer emails without inventing a broader email-extraction function.

P03 retained narrow compliance, completeness, error-checking, sanctions-screening and legal-relevance review scopes where the P/T/C supplies the relevant review purpose. Missing detailed rules, comparison implementation, approval authority or final verification accuracy alone is not a hold.

P04 retained inquiry response/drafting references supported by repeat-contact, routing/transfer burden, staff-time displacement or actual inquiry volume. AXV2C_0017_01 is a boundary reference for routing failure and repeated cross-channel explanation, not evidence of measured capacity or waiting reduction. AXV2N_0121 explicitly records help-search failure causing customer-centre recontacts, so its supported scope is repeat-contact burden relief; no measured volume reduction is inferred. These boundaries are not clear enough for additional holds without tightening the current reference-link policy.

No absent deployment, permissions, freshness, exact schema, citation, autonomous sending, transaction execution or performance details were turned into required conditions. Only source-audit.json is written.
